children: Arm Holdings (ARM, Financials) is riding a strong AI-driven surge, but its rising value is increasingly impossible to ignore.

The chip-design business said full-year revenue was $4.92 billion, up 22.8% from a year ago, with profit up 27%. CEO Rene Haas also pointed to significant demand in data centers, autos, robotics and edge computing.
Arm's foray into AI is giving it another growth area. We estimate the company has a $2 billion addressable potential for its AGI CPU business targeting new agentic AI applications.
Those growth possibilities have helped ARM shares jump more than 36% this week. The stock was up 3.2 percent at $333.20 at the closing Tuesday, the source said.

But the rally has also pushed up the valuation. According to Investing.com statistics, Arm is trading at around 143 times forecast earnings and 331 times EV/EBITDA, and the company has earned roughly $979 million in free cash flow.
That leaves it up to Arm to deliver solid performance in its licensing business and its newer AI endeavors to justify the premium investors are paying.
The next driver is how fast Arm's AI and data-center businesses translate into revenue and cash-flow growth over the next two fiscal years.

title: Arm Just Jumped 36% Now Its Valuation Is Raising Eyebrows
